Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Cairns hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Cairns hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 6, Agoda at 2, Booking.com at 2 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Cairns rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 7, Agoda at 2, Bluepillow.com at 1, Booking.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 8, no site was 5% or more below it. Taxes and fees at Cairns hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Little Drifter Cairns to 12% at Pacific Hotel Cairns. At 2 hotels the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
